name: dust-creek
description: A choose-your-own-adventure western, every picture drawn in code with anidoodle.

scripts.covers: node tools/still.mjs p01 --shot loop --scale 0.5 --out out/cover-dust-creek.png && node tools/still.mjs c01 --shot loop --scale 0.5 --out out/cover-corbenic.png && node tools/still.mjs r01 --shot loop --scale 0.5 --out out/cover-canicule.png && node tools/still.mjs f01 --shot loop --scale 0.5 --out out/cover-grands-bois.png && for b in dust-creek corbenic canicule grands-bois; do sips -s format jpeg -s formatOptions 82 out/cover-$b.png --out www/covers/$b.jpg >/dev/null; done && node tools/still.mjs p01 --shot loop --out out/plate-dust-creek.png && node tools/still.mjs c01 --shot loop --out out/plate-corbenic.png && node tools/still.mjs r01 --shot loop --out out/plate-canicule.png && node tools/still.mjs f01 --shot loop --out out/plate-grands-bois.png && for b in dust-creek corbenic canicule grands-bois; do sips -s format jpeg -s formatOptions 80 out/plate-$b.png --out www/covers/$b-plate.jpg >/dev/null; done
